newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby union-Randle replaces Telea on wing for Wellington.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Randle replaces Telea on wing for Wellington.

text.p: Roger Randle replaces the injured Alex Telea on the wing in the only change to the Wellington Hurricanes team for Saturday's Super 12 rugby semifinal against ACT Brumbies in Canberra, the New Zealand Press Association reports
It will be Randle's first match since he was charged with raping a South African women after the match against Natal in Durban early last month.
The New Zealand sevens representative has denied the charge. He is scheduled to appear in a Durban court on June 11.
Hurricanes coach Frank Oliver has retained Christian Cullen at fullback. There had been speculation Oliver would switch the All Black fullback to centre for the floodlit semifinal at Bruce Stadium.
Oliver denied the suggestion had come from him.

The Hurricanes lost 29-35 to the ACT Brumbies at Athletic Park last Sunday and missed out on the home advantage for the playoff. Auckland play Natal in the other semifinal, also on Saturday, at Eden Park.

Wellington: Christian Cullen, Tana Umaga, Mark Ranby, Jason O'Halloran, Roger Randle, Stephen Bachop, Jon Preston, Filo Tiatia, Martin Leslie, Mike Russell, Mark Cooksley, Kevin Barrett, Phil Coffin, Norm Hewitt, Mark Allen (captain).
Reserves: Richard Jarman, Jarrod Cunningham, Finau Maka, Dion Waller, Tala Leiasamaivao, Bill Cavubati.
